title: Show the promote verdict before the click: advance or hold, with coded reasons
deviations_from_card: Write set grew by ONE line-pair in app/features/tools/devcases/DevSubmissionRow.tsx (the EvalPanel call site: destructure promoteLanded/promoteError and pass verdict={{preview, landed, error}}) - the panel cannot receive the preview otherwise. Plus perf-budget.json (shared surface, under the lock) for the +1 leaf module on devcase-run.ts's route graph. Acceptance 8 -> 9 tests: case 7 also pins that a code-less 400 folds to an error (never a no-op), and the audit-sentence ordering has its own case. Series is catalogs (lock) -> doc (lock) -> feat (lib+routes+UI+tests together, since a test-only commit could not be green) -> perf budget. reasonCodes on PromoteResult are the full {code, params} reasons; the not_scored reason carries no params (the trail sentence takes the floor from the caller). The screening_review card's `confidence` now carries null for an unscored submission (decisionsAiReviewCardLogic already treats a non-number as no score). A server-truth-promoted row (promoted before this session) shows the plain 'In pipeline' rather than restating the preview, since the preview may use a newer floor than the one it landed at. Promote route's code-less 400/404 refusals unchanged (they fold to the localized generic 'failed' line).
notes: Full test:unit exit 1 on two foreign files only: recipes-literals.test.ts (PassPreviewModal.tsx noticeAmber grew, sibling pipeline work) and rate-limit-contract.test.ts (jds/[slug]/ingest-job route, sibling). All 414 tests across app/_lib/devcase*, app/api/devcase/** and app/features/tools/devcases/* pass. test:perf: every route overage was this card's (verified by removing the one import: zero route lines over) and is raised in c651b1634; remaining red is job-ingest.ts (pre-existing) and app/page.tsx 8863 KB vs 8855 - ~8 KB beyond this card's measured +13 KB share, belonging to another in-flight builder (a sibling raised the page in dda311b04 meanwhile). Whole-tree tsc red only on foreign paths (job-workspace-state/jobs publish tests, decisionsScreenWaveMachine.test, ScheduleTabPendingList, untracked kpi-sim/). The postings route now imports devcase-orchestrator (activePromoteFloor), already on the promote route's graph; postings was not over budget.
